a little something from me to you

For You,
Honey ♡

I know a website can't fix what I did. But I wanted to make something instead of simply saying “sorry.” You mean too much to me.

What I'm Sorry For 💔

Honey, I'm genuinely sorry for breaking my promise about cigarettes. I know I gave you my word, and then I didn't live up to it. I understand why that hurt you and why it made you feel disappointed in me.

You trusted what I said, and I should have respected that trust. I'm not going to make excuses for it. I was wrong, and I'm sorry.

I'm sorry.
I love you.
I'll do better. ♡
always you ♡

What You Mean To Me ❤️

You are the best, Honey. You make ordinary days feel special, and having you in my life means more to me than I sometimes know how to explain.

I don't want one stupid mistake to become bigger than everything beautiful we've shared. I appreciate you, I love you, and I never want you to feel like your trust is something I can take for granted.

You're my favourite person, my comfort, and one of the most important parts of my life.

What I'll Change 🌱

I don't want this apology to just be words. I want you to see the difference in what I do.

01 — Keep my word.
I won't make promises casually. If I promise you something, I want my actions to match it.
02 — Be honest.
If I mess up, I'll tell you instead of hiding it or making excuses.
03 — Respect your trust.
I know trust is built through consistency, not one emotional apology.
04 — Do better.
No dramatic promises. Just better choices, repeatedly.

one last thing

I'm not asking you to forget.

I'm asking you to let my actions show you that I learned from this. You deserve honesty, consistency, and someone who takes your feelings seriously.

I love you, Honey. I'm really sorry. ❤️
